Today, we continue to develop advanced welding and cutting solutions that help shape the future of manufacturing worldwide. 📍 Gothenburg, Sweden Position Purpose The Global Project Manager has global responsibility for establishing, leading, and continuously improving project management excellence across the Global Filler Metals organization and leading and delivering complex, high-value projects across multiple geographies, business units, and time zones. This senior role requires a seasoned professional who combines strategic vision with rigorous delivery discipline, operating at the intersection of business transformation, cross-functional collaboration, and executive stakeholder engagement. The successful candidate will serve as the primary accountability holder for end-to-end project delivery, ensuring outcomes are delivered on time, within budget, and to the agreed quality standards — while navigating the unique challenges of global operations including cultural diversity, regulatory variation, and distributed teams. Key Accountabilities Global Project Management Governance: Establish and own the global project management framework, standards, and governance model for Global Filler Metals. Define portfolio prioritization, stage gates, milestone reviews, escalation paths, and execution KPIs. Ensure clear accountability and ownership across GPM, R&D, sourcing, operations, and regional teams within a matrix organization. Provide leadership to ensure on-time, predictable delivery of critical global and cross-functional initiatives. Project Delivery & Execution: Drive disciplined execution, transparency, and follow-through, reducing delays and recurring escalations. Lead the full project lifecycle from initiation through to closure, including planning, execution, monitoring, and benefits realization Define and manage project scope, schedule, budget, quality, resources, and risks across global workstreams Develop and maintain detailed project plans, milestone schedules, and critical path analyses: Ensure delivery against agreed KPIs, tolerances, and stage gate criteria Manage project interdependencies and interfaces with other programs and business change initiatives Stakeholder & Relationship Management: Build and maintain strong relationships with senior leaders, sponsors, and global stakeholders across cultures and time zones Facilitate Steering Committee meetings, working groups, and cross-functional workshops Develop and execute stakeholder engagement and communication plans Act as primary point of escalation and resolution for all project-related issues Represent the project at Functional leadership level and in external partner/vendor meetings as required Required Qualifications Bachelor’s or master’s degree in engineering, Business, Project Management, or related field. Demonstrated experience leading global, cross-functional initiatives at a senior leadership level. Proven success operating in complex, matrix-based industrial or manufacturing organizations. Strong executive communication, stakeholder influence, and change leadership capabilities. Fluent in English. Swedish is a merit Preferred Qualifications Experience in engineered products, materials, or industrial manufacturing. Formal project management certification (PMP, Prince2, Agile, or equivalent). Experience with product data structures, master data governance, or portfolio management. Exposure to digitalization or workflow transformation initiatives. Success Measures Predictable, on-time delivery of global projects. Reduced project delays, rework, and escalations. High data accuracy, consistency, and usability supporting GPM. Adoption of standardized project governance and workflows. Improved cross-functional alignment and execution efficiency. What we can offer: Additional Benefits: Annual performance bonus, car allowance, service-based financial bonuses. Hybrid Work: Enjoy flexibility with a modern hybrid work environment. LinkedIn Learning Access: Expand your skills with unlimited learning opportunities. Continuous Performance Feedback: Grow through regular, structured performance discussions. Supportive Environment: Thrive in a collaborative culture that values your contribution. Career Opportunities: Grow and develop your career in alignment with your aspirations. 🚀 Please send your English CV — and let’s Shape the Future Together!

review_candidates.title: Global Manager Production
review_candidates.description: As Global Manager Production, you will lead the global seed production strategy and execution for the Mid-Tech Business Dynamic. You will shape and realize our business objectives, build strong production capabilities and lead a high-performing team. In this role, you help ensure reliable seed supply worldwide and support our purpose: ‘Breeding to feed the world’ by delivering innovative vegetable varieties across the globe. Make a difference as Global Manager Production As Global Manager Production, you are accountable for the global seed production performance for the Mid-Tech Business Dynamics. This means ensuring the right quantity, quality, timing, and cost of seed production while contributing to the strategic objectives of Enza Zaden. You will be responsible for developing and implementing the production strategy and operational plans for the assigned crop portfolio. Working closely with Business Dynamic leadership, Supply Chain, R&D and commercial teams, you will ensure alignment between long-term business objectives and production execution. You will also represent Production within the cross-functional Business Dynamic team en Crop Segment teams and contribute to the development and realization of strategic plans and annual objectives. In this role, your work will include: Leading and developing a team of production professionals to achieve business goals; Leading supplier performance management in close collaboration with the Global Contract Manager; Ensuring compliance with quality, phytosanitary, IP protection, and regulatory requirements; Contributing to crop strategic plans and preparing business cases for new production concepts and innovations; Leading production topics within the Tactical Seed Supply Team and ensuring effective communication between strategic and operational teams; Monitoring performance, identifying improvement opportunities, and driving continuous improvement initiatives; Actively contributing as a member of the Production Management Team to departmental strategy and execution. You will report to the VP Production and play an active role within both the Business Dynamic team and the Production Management Team. What You Bring As Our Future Colleague As Global Manager Production, you are an inspiring leader with strong people management capabilities and a proven ability to lead cross-functional teams in a complex international environment. You combine strategic thinking with operational excellence and are comfortable making decisions based on data and business insights. You are skilled at stakeholder management, thrive in a dynamic environment, and have a passion for driving continuous improvement and business performance. In addition, you have: A university degree (Master's level) in Agricultural Engineering, Seed Production, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, or a related field; 12 or more years of relevant experience in seed production, seed supply chain, or a comparable international environment; Hands on experience in working with cross functional teams and leading your own team; Strong analytical skills and experience working with complex datasets and business challenges; Demonstrated expertise in process improvement and project management; Good understanding of financial management and business planning; Excellent communication skills and proficiency in English and Dutch Enza Zaden as your employer Enza Zaden is an international family-owned company that has been developing innovative vegetable varieties since 1938. Together with more than 3,300 colleagues worldwide, we work on vegetable seeds with better flavor, higher yield and strong resistances. We do this from our mission: “Breeding to feed the world.” Every day, more than 480 million people eat vegetables grown from our seeds, and that is something we are very proud of. We’re passionate about our work and care about one another. Good ideas are given room to grow and together we keep moving forward. This is how we continue to grow and innovate, both as a company and as colleagues. What You Can Expect From Us We believe it is important that you can grow in your work and feel good about what you do. That is why we invest in your development, well-being, and job satisfaction. Through our Great to Grow development program, our focus on vitality, and activities that bring colleagues together, we create a work environment where you can keep learning and contribute with energy and enjoyment. You can also count on: A position for 38 hours per week; A gross monthly salary between € €7,774.05 and €11,105.78, based on a full-time workweek of 38 hours and aligned with your knowledge and experience; 8.33% vacation allowance and an attractive annual bonus program of 15% of your annual salary, depending on your job level and company performance; 25 vacation days, the option to purchase additional vacation days, and one paid vitality day per year, with extra vacation days granted as you get older; A laptop and mobile phone provided by Enza Zaden; A company car; A contribution toward overnight accommodation costs if you live farther away from Enza Zaden. This program applies to employees working for Enza Zaden in the Netherlands whose one-way commute exceeds 100 kilometers and 75 minutes; An attractive retirement plan, commuting reimbursement if you live more than 10 kilometers from your workplace and a remote work allowance when working partly from home in consultation with your manager; Opportunities for personal and professional growth through our Great to Grow development program, training courses, workshops, and e-learning platform; Plenty of opportunities to connect with colleagues outside of your daily work through social events organized by the Staff Association, as well as Young Enza networking events, inspiration sessions, and social gatherings. We also host an annual summer barbecue, Christmas market and New Year’s reception; A strong focus on your health and well-being, including free fresh fruit, healthy lunch options at the office, a bike-to-work program, sports activities through enzActive, and mental well-being support through OpenUp. Let’s connect Looking for a career that grows with you? Apply using the application button. You will receive an automatic confirmation within a few minutes. We will let you know the next step within 10 business days. Do you have questions about the role or the application process? Please feel free to contact Esther Scharloo, Senior Recruiter at e.scharloo@enzazaden.nl or call/whatsapp +31 6 25 47 35 44. Enza Zaden is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate based on background, identity, or personal characteristics. Want to learn more about Enza Zaden? Visit our website.

Envía tu CV a: jgonzalez@img.hospital

review_candidates.title: Flight Control & Dynamics Engineer
review_candidates.description: About Us Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces. Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected. About The Role Harmattan AI is pushing the boundaries of high-speed autonomous flight, where control has to hold up at the edge of the envelope. Getting that right across a family of airframes is one of the most demanding parts of the flight software. As a Flight Control & Dynamics Engineer, working out of Lausanne, Paris, or Zurich, you will own control law design and the system identification that feeds it, setting the control standard as the team grows. You will weigh classical against learning-based methods, from tuned control laws to reinforcement-learning policies trained in simulation and flown on hardware, and decide what actually flies. Responsibilities System Identification: Design excitation maneuvers and fit airframe models from flight data, with quantified error bounds. Control Law Design & Tuning: Inner rate and attitude loops through outer position loops, with allocation, gain scheduling, and manual or automated tuning across the airframe family and flight envelope. Sim-to-Real: Keep the in-house simulator faithful to the identified model, so control developed in simulation transfers to the aircraft. Model Consumption: Turn the stability derivatives and coefficient tables from Aerodynamics into flying control. Flight Test & Diagnosis: Verify across simulation, SITL, and HITL, including Monte Carlo campaigns, then fly and iterate from logs. Mentorship: Depending on seniority, support the team by mentoring junior control and GNC engineers. Candidate Requirements Educational Background: A strong academic record with a degree in aerospace, controls, robotics, or a related STEM field. A practical track record matters more than the specific degree. System Identification & Control: Proven, hands-on identification and control on multirotor or fixed-wing platforms, validated in flight, with depth in at least one of MPC, INDI, or geometric control. Embedded Realization: Real-time control implementation on constrained targets, split cleanly between a microcontroller and a companion computer. Learning-Based Control: Familiarity with reinforcement learning and simulation-based training, and the judgment to know when a learned policy beats a classical design. Professional Attributes: Empirical and hardware-honest, disciplined about experiments and validation, grounded in real flight data. Communicates clearly, able to present control and test results to engineers and senior stakeholders. Thrives under pressure in a fast-paced environment with a no-task-is-too-small mentality. Bonus: Multi-airframe or hover-to-cruise transition experience. Commitment: 100% dedication to Harmattan AI's mission of providing a defensive edge to allied nations through ethical, high-impact technology. We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

We own and operate the Esrange Space Center in Kiruna, northern Sweden, with the aim of launching satellites in the near future. Are you fueled by a passion for people and the ambition to create an awesome workplace? Are you ready to embark on an exciting journey with us to help Earth benefit from space? If you answer yes to these questions, we invite you to seize the opportunity to make a significant impact as Fluidic Ground Support Equipment (FGSE) Spaceport Engineer in our team. We are looking for a dedicated person who shares our core values of Customer passion, Care, Collaboration, Curiosity, and Courage. Requirements As a FGSE Spaceport Engineer, you play an important role in enabling safe, reliable, and efficient rocket launch operations. You are responsible for the design, development, implementation, and lifecycle ownership of ground systems supporting vehicle fluid and propulsion systems. The role combines hands-on engineering, system ownership, and close collaboration with operations, suppliers, and customers throughout testing and launch campaigns. In This Role, You Will Collaborate with coworkers and customers to analyze the requirements of ground- and vehicle systems, testing procedures, safety standards, and operational needs. Oversee assembly and integration of systems and components for cryogenic fluids and gases. Coordinate with suppliers, technicians, and other stakeholders to ensure timely and accurate implementation. Have the ownership of systems and subsystems critical to the execution of rocket launch campaigns, resolving issues encountered during the life of the systems. Lead the Concept of Operations definition with the rest of the operational team. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to provide technical support and guidance related to system usage. Both internally and directly with the end-user/customer on site. Continuous improvement of system designs, processes, and workflows to enhance efficiency, reliability, and safety. Incorporate feedback from users and stakeholders to drive iterative improvements. Be an active console operator during tests and launch campaign chronologies in the Launch Control Center Responsibilities To thrive in this role, you have a drive to provide excellence in technical solutions as well as a drive to learn new things. You like technical challenges, collaboration, and teamwork in an international environment. You have some years of experience working with fluid and Cryogenic systems, preferably both hardware and software. You can describe your designs and ideas to customers and colleagues with the ability to communicate complex technical solutions in an easy and understandable way. As required in the Space business, you can write technical documentation and follow formal processes. As well as being a hands-on engineer with a taste for practical work on-site. Benefits WE OFFER YOU A unique opportunity to contribute to a wide range of projects and play an active role in both the Swedish and international space industry. An excellent opportunity for personal and career development. An exciting, international workplace characterized by an open atmosphere and proud employees all over the world. Additional Benefits In addition to vacation and traditional public holidays, we offer extra paid leave throughout the year, such as time off between Christmas and New Year, Ascension Day, amounting to 6-11 extra days depending on the calendar. Wellness allowance of SEK 5,000 per year. Health benefits such as voluntary health insurance and regular health checks for eligible employees. Access to a benefit bike through a tax-efficient leasing program. Support for employee-driven activities that promote connection, health, and culture across teams. Collective Agreement, including good pensions plans, parental pay and insurance. LOCATION This is a full-time, permanent position based at our spaceport at Esrange outside of Kiruna. FURTHER INFORMATION For questions regarding employment terms or union-related matters, you are welcome to contact our union representatives: Sveriges Ingenjörer: SverigesIngenjorer-AF@sscspace.com Unionen: unionen@sscspace.com NEXT STEP If this opportunity sparks your interest, we encourage you to apply as soon as possible! We review applications continuously and will conduct interviews throughout the process. You can submit your application up until 2026-09-20, which is the latest possible date for consideration. Please note, however, that the position may be filled before this date, and the advertisement may therefore close earlier. This allows us to manage the process efficiently and give each application the attention it deserves. When applying, please include your CV. While you are welcome to include a brief personal note or letter, our evaluation will primarily focus on your skills and qualifications as outlined in your CV, ensuring a fair and unbiased recruitment process. This is a security-classified position and will require a background check prior to employment. WE HELP EARTH BENEFIT FROM SPACE SSC Space is a leading global provider of advanced space services, with more than 50 years of experience. We help space organizations, research institutes, commercial and institutional actors from all over the world to get access to space. With local presence on all continents and about 800 committed employees, we offer specialist expertise in satellite communications and satellite control services, spacecraft operations, rocket and balloon systems, launch services and flight test services, as well as engineering, operations and consultancy services for space missions. We help Earth benefit from Space. Learn more at sscspace.com

review_candidates.description: Job Summary General Atomics (GA), and its affiliated companies, is one of the world’s leading resources for high-technology systems development ranging from the nuclear fuel cycle to remotely piloted aircraft, airborne sensors, and advanced electric, electronic, wireless and laser technologies. General Atomics Electromagnetic Systems (GA-EMS) designs and manufactures first-of-a-kind electromagnetic and electric power generation systems. GA-EMS' expanding portfolio of specialized products and integrated system solutions support critical fleet, space systems and satellites, missile defense, power and energy, and process and monitoring applications for defense, industrial, and commercial customers worldwide. We have an exciting opportunity for an Electrical Engineering (EE) Manager to join our Electrical Technologies team located in Rancho Bernardo. We are looking for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, Research and Development (R&D) environment and possesses drive, talent, and experience in Electrical Wiring Interconnect Systems (EWIS) using intelligent Electrical and Mechanical Computer-Aided Design (ECAD/MCAD) tools and approaches. The successful candidate will report to the Director of Electrical Technologies and, alongside high-caliber engineering management staff, will be engaged in the engineering support and new development of high-power electromagnetic systems, high-energy laser systems, laser and electro-optical sensors for airborne payloads and space vehicles, satellite space systems, cutting-edge technology ventures into Defense and “NewSpace,” and a variety of disruptive technologies in the expanding product portfolio of GA-EMS. DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES: Responsible for the planning, managing and technical performance of an engineering unit through all phases of assigned project(s) from inception through completion. Participate with technical staff, program managers and executive management to develop and implement current, annual and long-term technical, schedule, quality, business and financial objectives for the unit. Work with GA-EMS Engineering staff in the concept development and prototype design, integration, and test of electrical systems and electronics for all product lines and technology areas. These encompass high-power motor drives, power conditioning systems, pulsed power systems, battery systems, high energy laser systems, satellite space systems, and laser and electro-optical sensors for airborne payloads and space vehicles. Participate in and coordinate the establishment of design concepts, criteria, and engineering efforts for product research, development, integration, and testing. Interface internally with engineering teams and/or with suppliers, vendors or customers to share information for problem resolution. Act as primary contact for engineering activities. Participate in the preparation of proposals, business plans, proposal work statements and specifications, operating budgets and financial terms/conditions of contract(s). Ensure technical leadership and excellence is maintained by participating in the planning, attraction, selection, retention, and development of the required management, professional, and technical talent. Identify engineering issues and provide leadership in developing solutions such as re-allocation of resources or modifying specifications. Participate in the development of new business opportunities and expansion of existing business opportunities. Generate electrical and wiring interconnect architecture solutions and technical approaches for new project needs, perform electrical engineering analyses for systems, document findings, communicate results to engineering and program management staff, give technical presentations, and manage technical effort schedules. Formulate plans, typically long-term, and coordinate solutions development and deployment including documentation, reporting, publishing, and making technical and other presentations to ensure viability of the solutions in an evolving environment. Plan for future applications of solutions based on new developments in engineering technology. Participate in or may lead the development of new or expansion of existing business opportunities. Communicate with colleagues and management throughout solution development and deployment cycles. Represent the company as a prime technical contact on contracts and/or projects and interact with senior external personnel on technical matters requiring coordination between the organizations. Perform other duties as assigned or required. We recognize and appreciate the value and contributions of individuals with diverse backgrounds and experiences and welcome all qualified individuals to apply. Job Qualifications Typically requires a Bachelors, Masters or PhD in engineering or a related technical field as well as nine or more years of progressively complex engineering experience. May substitute equivalent experience in lieu of education The ability to obtain and maintain a DoD Top Secret clearance is required. Required Experience: Electrical Wiring Interconnect System (EWIS) cable and harness design for high-reliability aerospace, space systems, and unmanned space vehicle applications; electro-mechanical integration of electrical engineering hardware including cables and harnessing, circuit boards, and electronics modules using intelligent ECAD/MCAD design tools and approaches in a collaborative, cross-functional engineering development environment; cross-functional systems architecture and design in product or technology development for complex, systems-of-systems; IPC-WHMA-620 Space Addendum; mixed-signal (analog/digital) electrical system interconnect design; analysis, design, and implementation of hardware systems to include digital, analog, power, laser/optical, and RF is required; familiarity with DoD technical review process (at a minimum: SRR, PDR, CDR, TRR) Desired Skills: Experience with EWIS Computer-Aided Design (CAD) tools such as Solidworks, Solidworks Electrical, AUTOCAD, CREO, Siemens Capital, Siemens NX, Rapid Harness, or Zuken; Printed Circuit Board (PCB) Electrical CAD tools such as Altium Design or Mentor Graphics PADS VX; Atlassian Collaboration Tools (Confluence, Crucible, JIRA); Microsoft Project. Demonstrate an extensive technical expertise and application of engineering principles, concepts, theory, and practice with the ability to organize, plan, schedule, conduct, and coordinate workloads of an engineering unit to meet established deadlines or milestones with experience in project leadership. Must possess the ability to understand new concepts quickly and apply them accurately throughout an evolving environment. Strong communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills to effectively interface with other departments, customers, government representatives, and/or professionals. Capable of representing the organization as a prime technical contact. Customer-focused and able to formulate plans based on the development of innovative new designs in resolving advanced technical engineering problems. review_candidates.title: ERP System Analyst
review_candidates.description: About the Team: You will be part of Sea’s HQ Finance department, which plays an integral role in supporting the accounting and finance needs of our three core businesses (Garena, Shopee, Monee) and across our diverse regional market presence. Within the department, the Data & Systems function is responsible for the development, implementation, integration, and maintenance of enterprise finance applications, enabling efficient and scalable operations through robust system solutions. You will support the day-to-day operations of enterprise resource planning applications and related finance systems across the organization. Job Description: Serve as a point of contact for internal stakeholders on ERP-related queries, issues, and service requests. Perform troubleshooting through diagnostic techniques and structured problem-solving. Support and maintain finance systems, including ERP system (Oracle EBS R12) and other inhouse applications, covering configurations, setups, and user access management. Maintain user-level and technical documentation; document system changes, configurations, and troubleshooting guides. Assist in the development and enhancement of finance systems — including robust testing of new functionality, processes, and setups — and prepare sign-off documentation. Work with Finance teams to clarify business requirements, map them to system capabilities, and recommend appropriate technical solutions. Participate in and occasionally lead project workstreams; coordinate with Finance and IT stakeholders, and keep relevant parties informed of progress. Identify and propose system improvements or solutions for current and future requirements using existing or emerging tools. Support audit-related activities including SOX ITGC and ITAC compliance tasks. Requirements: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Accountancy, Information Systems, or a related field. Minimally 1 year of experience in a similar role supporting ERP, EPM, or BI systems is preferred; graduates with relevant internship experience will be considered. Knowledge in programming language (e.g. SQL, VBA, and Python) is a plus. Showcases ability to quickly grasp both finance and technical concepts; comfortable with on-the-job learning. Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to work across functional and business teams. Excellent communication skills with ability to grasp complex concepts and communicate internally with all stakeholders. Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset with attention to detail. Self-driven and able to work independently when needed, while being a reliable team contributor.

review_candidates.title: Director, FP&A - Asia Pacific
review_candidates.description: Director, FP&A, Asia Pacific We are seeking a Director FP&A to support the APAC CFO and provide senior financial leadership across the region at a time of increasing complexity, ongoing transformation and heightened expectations from Group Finance. This role will act as the APAC CFO’s principal thought partner, with responsibility for management reporting, financial analysis, performance storytelling, and stakeholder management across the region. The role will work closely with sub‑regional CFOs, the APAC CEO and Leadership Team, CFO International, and Group Finance and can be based in either Hong Kong, Malaysia, the Philippines or Singapore. This role is well suited to a senior finance leader (e.g. Head of FP&A, Head of Management Reporting, Head of Business Performance, Commercial Finance Leader, Senior Manager FP&A) with experience operating in complex, multi‑country environments and a strong appetite to work at enterprise and executive level. Aon is in the business of better decisions At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world. As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed. What The Day Will Look Like Strategic Finance & Executive Support Act as a trusted thought partner to the APAC CFO, supporting regional financial leadership, prioritization and decision‑making. Represent the APAC CFO, as required, in meetings with CFO International, Group Finance, APAC Leadership, and other senior stakeholders. Support engagement with the APAC CEO and Leadership Team, providing clear financial insight, challenge and perspective. Management Reporting & Financial Narrative Lead the end‑to‑end APAC management reporting cycle, including monthly, quarterly and ad‑hoc executive reporting. Drive monthly forecasting and annual operating and strategic planning cycles for APAC, from beginning to end. Own the interpretation and synthesis of APAC financial performance, ensuring a clear, consistent and decision‑ready narrative. Review and enhance Group‑produced reporting packs by adding insight, context, and regional perspective relevant to APAC leadership. Develop and present high‑quality revenue and salary walks / bridges, clearly articulating performance drivers, risks and opportunities. Coordinate monthly Risks and Opportunities process, driving accountability and ownership through data and analytics. Group Finance Interface & Analytical Leadership Act as the primary APAC interface for Group Finance on management reporting, analysis and data requests. Lead regional coordination and responses to Group Finance requests. Ensure accuracy, consistency, and credibility of APAC submissions, while constructively challenging assumptions and requests where appropriate. Stakeholder Management Across APAC Work closely with sub‑regional CFOs to gather inputs, align assumptions, challenge drivers, and ensure high‑quality outputs. Balance strong collaboration with constructive challenge to drive consistency, discipline and insight across the region. Help orchestrate regional finance timelines, processes, and cross‑functional dependencies. Projects, Transformation & Digitization Lead or support regional finance projects, including reporting transformation, simplification, and digitization initiatives. Drive continuous improvement in reporting efficiency, data quality, automation and analytical capability. Support broader transformation initiatives across Finance and the business as and when required. Skills And Experience That Will Lead To Success Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting or equivalent experience. Accounting qualification is good to have. Insurance and/or Brokerage or wider Financial Services experience is a must have. Proven experience in a finance leadership role within a complex, regional or global organization. Strong background in management reporting, FP&A, performance analysis and storytelling. Experience working closely with senior business leaders and global finance teams. Demonstrated ability to translate complex financial information into clear, actionable insight. Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills across geographies and cultures. 2026-103824

review_candidates.title: Consultant Neurosurgeon - UAE / Exceptional Tax-Free Salary / Premium Hospital
review_candidates.description: About The Role An internationally accredited UAE healthcare provider is expanding brain, spine, neurotrauma, and advanced neurosurgical services. The role supports internationally trained clinicians working with a diverse patient population in a modern, quality-driven healthcare environment. The successful candidate will work with consultants, nurses, allied health professionals, and modern diagnostic and treatment infrastructure. Key Responsibilities Assess and manage cranial, spinal, neurovascular, neuro-oncology, and neurotrauma cases according to expertise. Perform neurosurgical procedures with safe patient selection, consent, and perioperative planning. Coordinate care with neurology, intensive care, radiology, oncology, rehabilitation, and emergency teams. Manage acute neurological deterioration, postoperative care, complications, and long-term follow-up. Participate in multidisciplinary case conferences, tumor boards, and trauma pathways. Support surgical governance, infection control, audit, and patient safety initiatives. Requirements Hold a recognized specialist qualification such as an American Board, UK CCT or FRCS, European or national board certification, Canadian Royal College certification, Australian FRACS, Arab Board, MCh, DNB, FCPS, or equivalent. Be eligible for UAE licensing and facility credentialing. Applications are considered from internationally trained candidates across multiple regions, subject to licensing eligibility. Compensation And Benefits The package includes a highly competitive tax-free salary, with performance-based incentives where applicable. Benefits may include housing or accommodation support, medical insurance, annual return flights, professional indemnity coverage, continuing medical education support, and visa assistance. Final compensation depends on certification, experience, subspecialty expertise, procedural scope, and licensing eligibility. Licensing and Relocation Support Support is available for DHA, DOH, or MOH license conversion, DataFlow and credential verification, visa processing, and relocation guidance. Dedicated onboarding support is provided for transition into UAE clinical practice. Ideal Candidate Profile Strong clinical judgment with commitment to evidence-based practice and patient safety. Excellent communication with culturally diverse patients and multidisciplinary teams. Ability to adapt to UAE healthcare regulations, documentation standards, and hospital governance expectations. Interest in long-term career development within a UAE healthcare setting. Application Applicants should provide an updated CV and details of current licensing status or eligibility.
